engine_specification.turnover_calculation: Turnover = sum(|w_new - w_old|) / 2. Measures fraction of portfolio traded.
engine_specification.transaction_cost_application: Applied to gross turnover. One-way cost applied to each trade direction.
engine_specification.benchmark_comparison: Portfolio returns compared against BL-ECON-001 (equal-weight), BL-ECON-002 (SPY), BL-ECON-003 (cash).
engine_specification.missing_security_handling: Missing securities receive zero weight. Portfolio renormalized to sum to 1.
engine_specification.delisting_handling: Delisted securities treated as zero return from last available date. Position removed at next rebalance.
engine_specification.reproducibility: All portfolio construction is deterministic given inputs. Same scores always produce same portfolio.
